title: Umuvugiriza izahabu mu butayu
intro: Tekereza inkambi nini y’ubutayu mu kanya gato ko gutegereza no guhangayika. Umuyobozi ukomeye yagiye guhura n’Imana, asize umuryango ushishikajwe no kubona ikintu gifatika cyo gukomeza. Muri ako gace k’ituze, umuntu ushishikajwe n’ibyo yakoze agenda imbere afite amasezerano meza n’ikiremwa cy’ubwenge gisa n’aho kizima.
clues: Nari mu bavaga mu Misiri na Musa, nibonera ukuntu inyanja yacitsemo ibice kugira ngo duhunge.
Narebye igihe umuyobozi wacu yajyaga ku musozi mu gihe cy'amajoro mirongo ine kugira ngo ahabwe ubuyobozi.
Nakusanyije imitako mu bantu maze nyishushanya n'amaboko yanjye.
Naremye inyana itanga ijwi rirenga, maze mpamagarira abantu kuri yo.
Nafashe urushyi rw'umukungugu mu nzira y'intumwa ndujugunya mu byo nakoze.
Nahanganye na Musa maze ndamucira urubanza rwo kuvuga ngo 'ntunkoreho' maze tubane ukwacu, maze dusezerana ko tuzacirwa urubanza.

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo
options: Yasabye gusengwa nk'umwami ukomeye mu Misiri
Yubatse ubwato kugira ngo arokoke umwuzure ukomeye
Yategetse ko umuriro ukomeye utwika Ibrahim
Yaremye inyana ya zahabu yayobyaga Abisirayeli
Bateguye kwica Muhammad mu gihe cyo kwimuka
trial.answer: Yaremye inyana ya zahabu yayobyaga Abisirayeli

location.label: Ikintu cy'ingenzi
options: Agace k'umukungugu kavuye mu nzira y'intumwa
location.answer: Agace k'umukungugu kavuye mu nzira y'intumwa

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Yasenyutse kubera guturika gukomeye kwaturutse mu ijuru
Yarohamye mu nyanja ari kumwe n'ingabo zimukurikira
Yahamijwe kuvuga ngo 'ntunkoreho' mu ibanga ategereje urubanza
outcome.answer: Yahamijwe kuvuga ngo 'ntunkoreho' mu ibanga ategereje urubanza

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
